decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several backpacks ranging from general hiking to specialized hydration and waterproof bags. The Mubasel Gear Hydration Backpack (prod_backpacks_132) stood out due to its exceptional review count and rating, providing confidence in its durability and performance for hiking. The inclusion of a 2L bladder at a $35.99 price point makes it an excellent value compared to other daypacks.
